film_working_title: La última luz / The Last Light

creative_approach.premise: In 2026, a man returns to an island fort after an exile begun in 1980. An undelivered letter and the enduring light of a harbor lantern reconnect him with the woman and the place he left. Time periods are conveyed by practical costume, weather and architecture rather than magical geometry.
creative_approach.difference_from_published: Distinct photoreal cinematic fort/letter/lantern narrative with two documented eras and in-world coastal motion instead of painterly glowing-topology two-hero memory fantasy.
creative_approach.visual_language: restrained cinematic realism, steel-blue storm and copper lantern light
continuity_locks: coastal fort geometry remains fixed within each time period
older hero and younger hero must be recognizably one person
realistic wave, cloth, rain and flame motion only

first_proof.moving_regions: ocean-only warping and confined lamp flicker, no global camera motion
